{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01LpKS2BK64PsSPAyxswCChE","type":"tool_result","content":"#!/bin/sh\n# full_test.sh — scoring entry point. Do not filter, skip, or reinterpret.\n#\n# `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/full_test.sh` from the completed application root and takes its\n# exit code and output as the score. The interface check is separate from the conformance run so\n# that a missing or non-executable program and a genuine conformance failure are distinguishable\n# in the evidence. The program path is the harness's only knowledge of the implementation\n# language; the harness itself is language-neutral.\n#\n# The suite runs unfiltered: no --pattern, no --number, no selector of any kind. spec_tests.py\n# exits with failed + errored, so exit 0 means the complete CommonMark 0.31.2 suite passed.\nset -eu\n\nif [ ! -x ./commonmark ]; then\n    echo \"error: no executable ./commonmark at the application root.\" >&2\n    echo \"The deliverable is an executable named commonmark that reads UTF-8 Markdown on stdin\" >&2\n    echo \"and writes HTML to stdout.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# spec_tests.py imports cmark and normalize as siblings, so the staged directory has to be on the\n# import path. The program is passed absolute because the runner spawns it from its own cwd.\nPYTHONPATH=\"$PWD/sources${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}\"\nexport PYTHONPATH\n\nset +e\noutput=$(python3 sources/spec_tests.py --program \"$PWD/commonmark\" --spec sources/spec.txt 2>&1)\nstatus=$?\nset -e\n\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$output\"\n\n# The runner exits with failed + errored, which a shell truncates modulo 256: exactly 256 or 512\n# failures would exit 0 and read as a pass. The harness therefore confirms the tally rather than\n# trusting the status alone, and reports a clean run only when both agree. This is the scoring\n# instrument reading its own instrument; the acceptance check above it still asserts nothing but\n# this script's exit code.\nif [ \"$status\" -ne 0 ]; then\n    exit 1\nfi\nif ! printf '%s\\n' \"$output\" | grep -q '0 failed, 0 errored, 0 skipped'; then\n    echo \"error: conformance runner exited 0 but did not report a clean unfiltered suite.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n----\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\nfrom ctypes import CDLL, c_char_p, c_long, c_int\nfrom subprocess import *\nimport platform\nimport os\n\ndef pipe_through_prog(prog, text):\n    p1 = Popen(prog.split(), stdout=PIPE, stdin=PIPE, stderr=PIPE)\n    [result, err] = p1.communicate(input=text.encode('utf-8'))\n    return [p1.returncode, result, err]\n\ndef use_library(lib, text):\n    textbytes = text.encode('utf-8')\n    textlen = len(textbytes)\n    return [0, lib(textbytes, textlen, 0), '']\n\nclass CMark:\n    def __init__(self, prog=None, library_dir=None):\n        self.prog = prog\n        if prog:\n            self.to_html = lambda x: pipe_through_prog(prog, x)\n        else:\n            sysname = platform.system()\n            if sysname == 'Darwin':\n                libname = \"libcmark.dylib\"\n            elif sysname == 'Windows':\n                libname = \"cmark.dll\"\n            else:\n                libname = \"libcmark.so\"\n            if library_dir:\n                libpath = os.path.join(library_dir, libname)\n            else:\n                libpath = os.path.join(\"build\", \"src\", libname)\n            cmark = CDLL(libpath)\n            markdown = cmark.cmark_markdown_to_html\n            markdown.restype = c_char_p\n            markdown.argtypes = [c_char_p, c_long, c_int]\n            self.to_html = lambda x: use_library(markdown, x)\n----\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\ntry:\n    from html.parser import HTMLParseError\nexcept ImportError:\n    # HTMLParseError was removed in Python 3.5. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AdnDUWGUyEt1L6hSg6ATQm","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a backslash inside\n    it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not\n    open an autolink. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n----\n\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. The conformance runner compares normalized HTML, so tag structure and\nentities must match the spec examples.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport string\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import Block\n\nInlineParser = Callable[[str], str]\n\nESCAPES = ((\"&\", \"&amp;\"), (\"<\", \"&lt;\"), (\">\", \"&gt;\"), ('\"', \"&quot;\"))\nURL_SAFE_CHARS = frozenset(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + \";,/?:@&=+$-_.!~*'()#\")\nHEX_DIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)\n\n\ndef escape_html(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Escape &, <, > and \" so the text renders as literal characters. The ampersand goes first.\"\"\"\n    for raw, entity in ESCAPES:\n        text = text.replace(raw, entity)\n    return text\n\n\ndef percent_encode_url(url: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Percent-encode a URL for use in an attribute.\n\n    URL-safe ASCII and existing %XX escapes are kept. Every other character is encoded as its\n    UTF-8 bytes, so a lone % becomes %25.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(url):\n        char = url[index]\n        if char == \"%\" and _is_hex_pair(url[index + 1 : index + 3]):\n            out.append(url[index : index + 3])\n            index += 3\n            continue\n        if char in URL_SAFE_CHARS:\n            out.append(char)\n        else:\n            out.extend(f\"%{byte:02X}\" for byte in char.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _is_hex_pair(text: str) -> bool:\n    return len(text) == 2 and all(char in HEX_DIGITS for char in text)\n\n\ndef render_document(root: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Phase 2 walk: render the top-level blocks in order, one line ending after each block.\n\n    `parse_inline` is the inline parser hook. It receives the raw content of each paragraph and\n    returns that content's HTML.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(_render_block(child, parse_inline) for child in root.children)\n\n\ndef _render_block(block: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    if block.kind.name == \"paragraph\":\n        return f\"<p>{parse_inline(block.content)}</p>\\n\"\n    raise ValueError(f\"no HTML renderer for block type {block.kind.name!r}\")\n----\n\"\"\"Character references and backslash escapes.\n\nResponsibility: decode named entities (from the standard library table `html.entities.html5`,\nnames ending in a semicolon only) and numeric character references, and provide the backslash\nunescape helper.\n\"\"\"\n\"\"\"Link reference definitions: extraction, the document-wide reference map, and `normalize_label`.\n\nResponsibility: extract link reference definitions when a paragraph closes, store them in one\nreference map, and normalize labels with `str.casefold` plus whitespace collapse.\n\"\"\"\n\"\"\"mdparser: a CommonMark 0.31.2 parser delivered as the stdin-to-stdout `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe package uses only the Python standard library. Its phase-1 block structure and phase-2\ninline structure live in the modules below.\n\"\"\"\n----\n\"\"\"Process I/O boundary for the `commonmark` executable.\n\nResponsibility: read raw bytes from `sys.stdin.buffer`, decode UTF-8 with U+FFFD replacement,\nnormalize line endings, replace U+0000, and write HTML to `sys.stdout.buffer`. Diagnostics go to\n`sys.stderr` only, and the exit status is 0 for every input.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport sys\n\nfrom mdparser import blocks, inlines, render\n\nREPLACEMENT_CHARACTER = \"�\"\nLINE_ENDING_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n|\\r|\\n\")\n\n\ndef decode_source(data: bytes) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Decode raw input bytes as UTF-8, replacing each invalid byte with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    return data.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n\n\ndef split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Split text on LF, CR, or CRLF, and replace each U+0000 with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    text = text.replace(\"\\x00\", REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER)\n    return LINE_ENDING_PATTERN.split(text)\n\n\ndef render_lines(lines: list[str]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Parse the lines into a block tree and return the HTML document.\"\"\"\n    root = blocks.parse_lines(lines)\n    return render.render_document(root, inlines.parse_inline)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    \"\"\"Run the executable: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML. Always returns 0.\"\"\"\n    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()\n    try:\n        lines = split_lines(decode_source(data))\n        html = render_lines(lines)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"commonmark: internal error: {exc!r}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        html = \"\"\n    sys.stdout.buffer.write(html.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n----\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"commonmark: read UTF-8 Markdown on stdin and write HTML to stdout.\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__)))\n\nfrom mdparser.cli import main  # noqa: E402\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n----\nbin:\ntest.sh\n\ndata:\nlogs\n\ntests:\n__pycache__\nconftest.py\ntest_autolinks.py\ntest_block_engine.py\ntest_blocks.py\ntest_executable.py\ntest_foundation.py\ntest_render.py\n[project]\nname = \"mdparser\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"CommonMark 0.31.2 parser: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.11\"\ndependencies = []\n\n[dependency-groups]\ndev = [\n    \"pytest\",\n]\n\n[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths = [\"tests\"]\npythonpath = [\".\"]\naddopts = \"-ra\"\n# Runtime\ndata/\n*.log\n\n# Environment\n.env\n.venv/\n\n# Python\n__pycache__/\n*.pyc\n*.egg-info/\ndist/\nbuild/\n\n# Tooling\n.pytest_cache/\n\n# OS\n.DS_Store\nThumbs.db","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d2552876-9ff5-44df-a9c6-4c989d6f1221","uuid":"54cf1019-1163-47be-bf0c-141884de4498","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:05:19.184Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FM5YkJ5uRDX3W1W6CVJduE","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the mdparser test suite.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nPROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef project_root() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Absolute path to the application root, where `commonmark` and `pyproject.toml` live.\"\"\"\n    return PROJECT_ROOT\n----\n\"\"\"Autolink tests: URI and email autolinks, the rejected forms, backslash handling, and href\nencoding, plus the executable's output for a whole document.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink is one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_corpus_section_passes_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-corpus-section: the scoped Autolinks conformance section exits 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Autolinks$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a href=\"ab:x\">ab:x</a>'),\n        (\"<a+b+c:d>\", '<a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<a.b-c:d>\", '<a href=\"a.b-c:d\">a.b-c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\", '<a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a>'),\n        (\"<localhost:5001/foo>\", '<a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a>'),\n        (\"<https://../>\", '<a href=\"https://../\">https://../</a>'),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_uri_autolink_renders_the_uri_as_href_and_label(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_32_characters_is_an_autolink() -> None:\n    scheme = \"a\" + \"b\" * 31\n    uri = scheme + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f'<a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a>'\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_33_characters_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    uri = \"a\" * 33 + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f\"&lt;{uri}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_one_letter_scheme_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<m:abc>\") == \"&lt;m:abc&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_scheme_starting_with_a_digit_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<1ab:x>\") == \"&lt;1ab:x&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_uri_query_ampersands_are_escaped_in_href_and_label() -> test_uri_non_ascii_characters_are_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/é>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%C3%A9\">http://e.com/é</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_backtick_is_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/`x>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%60x\">http://e.com/`x</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_with_an_existing_percent_escape_keeps_it() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a%20b>\") == (\n        '<a test_uri_containing_an_ascii_control_character_is_literal_text(control: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a\" + control + \"b>\") == (\n        \"&lt;http://e.com/a\" + control + \"b&gt;\"\n    )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"body\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"http://e.com/a b\", \"&lt;http://e.com/a b&gt;\"),\n        (\"http://e.com/<a\", href=\"http://e.com/a\">http://e.com/a</a>b'\n    )\n\n\n# --- Email autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"address\", \"expected_href\", \"expected_label\"),\n    [\n        (\"foo@bar.example.com\", \"mailto:foo@bar.example.com\", \"foo@bar.example.com\"),\n        (\n            \"foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com\",\n            \"mailto:foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com\",\n \"mailto:a.b!#$%25&amp;'*+/=?%5E_%60%7B%7C%7D~-@x.y\",\n            \"a.b!#$%&amp;'*+/=?^_`{|}~-@x.y\",\n        ),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_email_autolink_renders_mailto_href_and_address_label(\n )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"address\",\n    [\n        \"foo@-bar.com\",\n        \"foo@bar-.com\",\n        \"foo@bar..com\",\n        \"@bar.com\",\n        \"foo@\",\n        \"foo bar@x.com\",\n        \"foo@bär.com\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_malformed_email_is_literal_text(address: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + address + \">\") == f\"&lt;{address}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_email_label_longer_than_63_characters_in_a_label_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    label = \"a\" * 64\n    address = \"x@\" + label + \".com\"\n    assert Everything\n    else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:","originalFile":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a backslash inside\n    it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not\n    open an autolink. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.\n_WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\"\n# Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly.\n_WS_REQUIRED = r\"(?=[ \\t\\n])\" + _WS\n_TAG_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\"\n_ATTR_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:\\-]*\"\n# An unquoted value is nonempty and has no whitespace, quote, `=`, `<`, `>` or backtick.\n_UNQUOTED_VALUE = r\"[^ \\t\\n\\r\\\"'=<>`]+\"\n_ATTR_VALUE = rf\"(?:{_UNQUOTED_VALUE}|'[^']*'|\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\")\"\n_ATTRIBUTE = rf\"{_WS_REQUIRED}{_ATTR_NAME}(?:{_WS}={_WS}{_ATTR_VALUE})?\"\n# The raw HTML grammars from the spec, tried in order. Each one is anchored at the `<` by `match`.\nRAW_HTML_PATTERNS = tuple(\n    re.compile(pattern)\n    for pattern in (\n        rf\"<{_TAG_NAME}(?:{_ATTRIBUTE})*{_WS}/?>\",\n        rf\"</{_TAG_NAME}{_WS}>\",\n        # `<!-->` and `<!--->` are complete comments; any other comment ends at the first `-->`.\n        r\"<!--(?:>|->|(?s:.*?)-->)\",\n        r\"<\\?(?s:.*?)\\?>\",\n        r\"<![A-Za-z][^>]*>\",\n        r\"<!\\[CDATA\\[(?s:.*?)\\]\\]>\",\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink or raw HTML tag starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a\n    backslash inside it stays literal and is passed through byte for byte. A backslash before ASCII\n    punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not open an autolink or raw HTML. Everything\n    else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":96,"oldLines":6,"newStart":96,"newLines":15,"lines":["     return _link_html(href, body), match.end()"," "," ","+def _match_raw_html(raw: str, start: int) -> int | None:","+    \"\"\"Return the index just past the raw HTML construct at `start`, or None if none matches.\"\"\"","+    for pattern in RAW_HTML_PATTERNS:","+        match = pattern.match(raw, start)","+        if match is not None:","+            return match.end()","+    return None","+","+"," def _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:","     \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"","     return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01FsSynwxkiJe9CTTUfdcSWL","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1dLjgMmTmjqUHzrHQ8y","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01T18yMyJkPUyVHCe7yaQBVU","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_raw_html.py","content":"\"\"\"Raw inline HTML tests: open, closing, empty-element and attribute forms, comments, processing\ninstructions, declarations and CDATA sections, the rejected forms, and backslash inertness.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Raw-HTML.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_open_and_close_tags_pass_through(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-open-and-close-tags: open, self-closing and closing tags pass through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    tags = '<a><bab><c2c> <a href=\"x\" data-k=v /> </a></foo >'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Foo \" + tags + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>Foo {tags}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: Path, fragment: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-comment-pi-declaration-cdata: each construct passes through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + fragment + \" bar\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {fragment} bar</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_illegal_forms_are_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-closing-tag-with-attributes: a closing tag with attributes is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, '</a href=\"foo\">\\n')\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;/a href=&quot;foo&quot;&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_backslash_in_attribute_value_is_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-backslash-inert: a backslash inside a tag attribute value is kept as written.\"\"\"\n    tag = '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + tag + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {tag}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Open, closing and empty-element tags ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"tag\",\n    [\n        \"<a>\",\n        \"<a/>\",\n        \"<a  />\",\n        \"<b2/>\",\n        \"<a-b c-d>\",\n        \"<a h=x>\",\n        \"<a h='x'>\",\n        '<a h=\"x y\">',\n        \"<a b>\",\n        \"<a b c>\",\n        \"<a b = c>\",\n        \"<a _b:c.d-e=1>\",\n        \"<a\\nb>\",\n        \"<a  /><b2\\ndata=\\\"foo\\\" >\",\n        \"<a \\n  b=\\\"c\\\">\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_open_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"tag\", [\"</a>\", \"</a >\", \"</a\\n>\", \"</a\\t  >\", \"</a-b2>\"])\ndef test_legal_closing_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"source\",\n    [\n        '<a b=\"x\"c>',\n        '<a b=\"unclosed>',\n        '<a b=\"x\\'>',\n        \"<a b=>\",\n        \"<a b=x y='z>\",\n        \"<a b=x\\\"y>\",\n        \"<a=b>\",\n        \"<1a>\",\n        \"<-a>\",\n        \"<a b=c<d>\",\n        \"<a b=c`>\",\n        \"<a\\n\\nb>\",\n        \"</a/>\",\n        \"</a b>\",\n        \"</>\",\n        \"<a/ >\",\n        \"<a b c\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_illegal_tag_form_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\ndef test_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a href=\"\\\\*\">') == '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n\n\ndef test_unquoted_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a b=\\\\*>\") == \"<a b=\\\\*>\"\n\n\ndef test_entity_text_in_attribute_value_is_passed_through_unchanged() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a title=\"&amp;&copy;\">') == '<a title=\"&amp;&copy;\">'\n\n\ndef test_quoted_attribute_value_may_span_a_line_ending() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a b=\"x\\ny\">') == '<a b=\"x\\ny\">'\n\n\n# --- Comments ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"comment\",\n    [\n        \"<!-->\",\n        \"<!--->\",\n        \"<!---->\",\n        \"<!-- a comment -->\",\n        \"<!-- a -- b -->\",\n        \"<!--\\nline one\\nline two\\n-->\",\n        \"<!-- > -->\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_comment_passes_through_unchanged(comment: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(comment) == comment\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"source\", [\"<!-- unclosed\", \"<!--\", \"<!---\"])\ndef test_unclosed_comment_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\n# --- Processing instructions ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"instruction\", [\"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<??>\", \"<? x\\ny ?>\", \"<?>?>\"])\ndef test_legal_processing_instruction_passes_through_unchanged(instruction: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(instruction) == instruction\n\n\ndef test_unclosed_processing_instruction_is_escaped_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<?php echo\") == \"&lt;?php echo\"\n\n\n# --- Declarations ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"declaration\", [\"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<!DOCTYPE html>\", \"<!a>\"])\ndef test_legal_declaration_passes_through_unchanged(declaration: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(declaration) == declaration\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"source\", [\"<! x>\", \"<!1x>\", \"<!a\", \"<!>\"])\ndef test_illegal_declaration_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\n# --- CDATA sections ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"section\", [\"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\", \"<![CDATA[]]>\", \"<![CDATA[a\\nb]]>\"])\ndef test_legal_cdata_section_passes_through_unchanged(section: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(section) == section\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"source\", [\"<![CDATA[ unclosed\", \"<![cdata[x]]>\"])\ndef test_illegal_cdata_section_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\n# --- Backslash handling and precedence ---\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_less_than_prevents_a_raw_tag() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\<b>\") == \"&lt;b&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_raw_tag_text_between_escaped_text_keeps_its_order() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"AT&T <b>x</b> & <i>\") == \"AT&amp;T <b>x</b> &amp; <i>\"\n\n\ndef test_raw_tag_inside_text_keeps_surrounding_escapes() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('say \"hi\" <b class=\"x\">') == 'say &quot;hi&quot; <b class=\"x\">'\n\n\ndef test_raw_tag_text_between_escaped_text_keeps_its_order() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"AT&T <b>x</b> & <i>\") == \"AT&amp;T <b>x</b> &amp; <i>\"\n\n\ndef No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Raw-HTML.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_open_and_close_tags_pass_through(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-open-and-close-tags: open, self-closing and closing tags pass through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    tags = '<a><bab><c2c> <a href=\"x\" data-k=v /> </a></foo >'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Foo \" + tags + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>Foo {tags}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: Path, fragment: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-comment-pi-declaration-cdata: each construct passes through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + fragment + \" bar\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {fragment} bar</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_illegal_forms_are_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-closing-tag-with-attributes: a closing tag with attributes is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, '</a href=\"foo\">\\n')\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;/a href=&quot;foo&quot;&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_backslash_in_attribute_value_is_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-backslash-inert: a backslash inside a tag attribute value is kept as written.\"\"\"\n    tag = '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + tag + \"\\n\")\n No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Raw-HTML.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_open_and_close_tags_pass_through(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-open-and-close-tags: open, self-closing and closing tags pass through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    tags = '<a><bab><c2c> <a href=\"x\" data-k=v /> </a></foo >'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Foo \" + tags + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>Foo {tags}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: Path, fragment: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-comment-pi-declaration-cdata: each construct passes through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + fragment + \" bar\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {fragment} bar</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_illegal_forms_are_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-closing-tag-with-attributes: a closing tag with attributes is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, '</a href=\"foo\">\\n')\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;/a href=&quot;foo&quot;&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_backslash_in_attribute_value_is_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-backslash-inert: a backslash inside a tag attribute value is kept as written.\"\"\"\n    tag = '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + tag + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {tag}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Open, closing and empty-element tags ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"tag\",\n    [\n        \"<a>\",\n        \"<a/>\",\n        \"<a  />\",\n        \"<b2/>\",\n        \"<a-b c-d>\",\n        \"<a h=x>\",\n        \"<a h='x'>\",\n        '<a h=\"x y\">',\n        \"<a b>\",\n        \"<a b c>\",\n        \"<a b = c>\",\n        \"<a _b:c.d-e=1>\",\n        \"<a\\nb>\",\n        \"<a  /><b2\\ndata=\\\"foo\\\" >\",\n        \"<a \\n  b=\\\"c\\\">\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_open_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"tag\", [\"</a>\", \"</a >\", \"</a\\n>\", \"</a\\t  >\", \"</a-b2>\"])\ndef test_legal_closing_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        ('<a b=\"x\"c>', \"&lt;a b=&quot;x&quot;c&gt;\"),\n        ('<a b=\"unclosed>', \"&lt;a b=&quot;unclosed&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=>\", \"&lt;a b=&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=x y='z>\", \"&lt;a b=x y='z&gt;\"),\n        ('<a b=x\"y>', \"&lt;a b=x&quot;y&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a=b>\", \"&lt;a=b&gt;\"),\n        (\"<1a>\", \"&lt;1a&gt;\"),\n        (\"<-a>\", \"&lt;-a&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=c<d>\", \"&lt;a b=c&lt;d&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=c`>\", \"&lt;a b=c`&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a\\n\\nb>\", \"&lt;a\\n\\nb&gt;\"),\n        (\"</a/>\", \"&lt;/a/&gt;\"),\n        (\"</a b>\", \"&lt;/a b&gt;\"),\n        (\"</>\", \"&lt;/&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a/ >\", \"&lt;a/ &gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b c\", \"&lt;a b c\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_illegal_tag_form_is_escaped_text(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a href=\"\\\\*\">') == '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n\n\ndef test_unquoted_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a b=\\\\*>\") == \"<a b=\\\\*>\"\n\n\ndef test_entity_text_in_attribute_value_is_passed_through_unchanged() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a title=\"&amp;&copy;\">') == '<a title=\"&amp;&copy;\">'\n\n\ndef test_quoted_attribute_value_may_span_a_line_ending() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a b=\"x\\ny\">') == '<a b=\"x\\ny\">'\n\n\n# --- Comments ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"comment\",\n    [\n        \"<!-->\",\n        \"<!--->\",\n        \"<!---->\",\n        \"<!-- a comment -->\",\n        \"<!-- a -- b -->\",\n        \"<!--\\nline one\\nline two\\n-->\",\n        \"<!-- > -->\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_comment_passes_through_unchanged(comment: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(comment) == comment\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [(\"<!-- unclosed\", \"&lt;!-- unclosed\"), (\"<!--\", \"&lt;!--\"), (\"<!---\", \"&lt;!---\")],\n)\ndef test_unclosed_comment_is_escaped_text(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\n# --- Processing instructions ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"instruction\", [\"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<??>\", \"<? x\\ny ?>\", \"<?>?>\"])\ndef test_legal_processing_instruction_passes_through_unchanged(instruction: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(instruction) == instruction\n\n\ndef test_unclosed_processing_instruction_is_escaped_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<?php echo\") == \"&lt;?php echo\"\n\n\n# --- Declarations ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"declaration\", [\"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<!DOCTYPE html>\", \"<!a>\"])\ndef test_legal_declaration_passes_through_unchanged(declaration: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(declaration) == declaration\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"source\", [\"<! x>\", \"<!1x>\", \"<!a\", \"<!>\"])\ndef test_illegal_declaration_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\n# --- CDATA sections ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"section\", [\"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\", \"<![CDATA[]]>\", \"<![CDATA[a\\nb]]>\"])\ndef test_legal_cdata_section_passes_through_unchanged(section: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(section) == section\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"source\", [\"<![CDATA[ unclosed\", \"<![cdata[x]]>\"])\ndef test_illegal_cdata_section_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\n# --- Backslash No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Raw-HTML.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_open_and_close_tags_pass_through(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-open-and-close-tags: open, self-closing and closing tags pass through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    tags = '<a><bab><c2c> <a href=\"x\" data-k=v /> </a></foo >'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Foo \" + tags + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>Foo {tags}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: Path, fragment: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-comment-pi-declaration-cdata: each construct passes through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + fragment + \" bar\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {fragment} bar</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_illegal_forms_are_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-closing-tag-with-attributes: a closing tag with attributes is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, '</a href=\"foo\">\\n')\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;/a href=&quot;foo&quot;&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_backslash_in_attribute_value_is_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-backslash-inert: a backslash inside a tag attribute value is kept as written.\"\"\"\n    tag = '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + tag + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {tag}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Open, closing and empty-element tags ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"tag\",\n    [\n        \"<a>\",\n        \"<a/>\",\n        \"<a  />\",\n        \"<b2/>\",\n        \"<a-b c-d>\",\n        \"<a h=x>\",\n        \"<a h='x'>\",\n        '<a h=\"x y\">',\n        \"<a b>\",\n        \"<a b c>\",\n        \"<a b = c>\",\n        \"<a _b:c.d-e=1>\",\n        \"<a\\nb>\",\n        \"<a  /><b2\\ndata=\\\"foo\\\" >\",\n        \"<a \\n  b=\\\"c\\\">\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_open_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"tag\", [\"</a>\", \"</a >\", \"</a\\n>\", \"</a\\t  >\", \"</a-b2>\"])\ndef test_legal_closing_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        ('<a b=\"x\"c>', \"&lt;a b=&quot;x&quot;c&gt;\"),\n        ('<a b=\"unclosed>', \"&lt;a b=&quot;unclosed&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=>\", \"&lt;a b=&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=x y='z>\", \"&lt;a b=x y='z&gt;\"),\n        ('<a b=x\"y>', \"&lt;a b=x&quot;y&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a=b>\", \"&lt;a=b&gt;\"),\n        (\"<1a>\", \"&lt;1a&gt;\"),\n        (\"<-a>\", \"&lt;-a&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=c<d>\", \"&lt;a b=c&lt;d&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=c`>\", \"&lt;a b=c`&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a\\n\\nb>\", \"&lt;a\\n\\nb&gt;\"),\n        (\"</a/>\", \"&lt;/a/&gt;\"),\n        (\"</a b>\", \"&lt;/a b&gt;\"),\n        (\"</>\", \"&lt;/&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a/ >\", \"&lt;a/ &gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b c\", \"&lt;a b c\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_illegal_tag_form_is_escaped_text(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a href=\"\\\\*\">') == '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n\n\ndef test_unquoted_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a b=\\\\*>\") == \"<a b=\\\\*>\"\n\n\ndef test_entity_text_in_attribute_value_is_passed_through_unchanged() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a title=\"&amp;&copy;\">') == '<a title=\"&amp;&copy;\">'\n\n\ndef test_quoted_attribute_value_may_span_a_line_ending() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a b=\"x\\ny\">') == '<a b=\"x\\ny\">'\n\n\n# --- Comments ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"comment\",\n    [\n        \"<!-->\",\n        \"<!--->\",\n        \"<!---->\",\n        \"<!-- a comment -->\",\n        \"<!-- a -- b -->\",\n        \"<!--\\nline one\\nline two\\n-->\",\n        \"<!-- > -->\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_comment_passes_through_unchanged(comment: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(comment) == comment\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\n# --- Processing instructions ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"instruction\", [\"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<??>\", \"<? x\\ny ?>\", \"<?>?>\"])\ndef test_legal_processing_instruction_passes_through_unchanged(instruction: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(instruction) == instruction\n\n\ndef test_unclosed_processing_instruction_is_escaped_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<?php echo\") == \"&lt;?php echo\"\n\n\n# --- Declarations ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"declaration\", [\"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<!DOCTYPE html>\", \"<!a>\"])\ndef test_legal_declaration_passes_through_unchanged(declaration: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(declaration) == declaration\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [(\"<! x>\", \"&lt;! x&gt;\"), (\"<!1x>\", \"&lt;!1x&gt;\"), (\"<!a\", \"&lt;!a\"), (\"<!>\", \"&lt;!&gt;\")],\n)\ndef test_illegal_declaration_is_escaped_text(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\n# --- CDATA sections ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"section\", [\"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\", \"<![CDATA[]]>\", \"<![CDATA[a\\nb]]>\"])\ndef test_legal_cdata_section_passes_through_unchanged(section: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(section) == section\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"source\", [\"<![CDATA[ unclosed\", \"<![cdata[x]]>\"])\ndef test_illegal_cdata_section_is_escaped_text(source: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == _escaped(source)\n\n\n# --- Backslash handling and precedence ---\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_less_than_prevents_a_raw_tag() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\<b>\") == \"&lt;b&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_raw_tag_text_between_escaped_text_keeps_its_order() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"AT&T <b>x</b> & <i>\") == \"AT&amp;T class=\"x\">'\n\n\ndef test_two_raw_tags_in_one_line_both_pass_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a><b>\") == \"<a><b>\"\n\n\ndef No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Raw-HTML.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_open_and_close_tags_pass_through(project_root: = run_executable(project_root, \"Foo \" + tags + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>Foo {tags}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: bar\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {fragment} bar</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_illegal_forms_are_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-closing-tag-with-attributes: a closing tag with attributes is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, '</a href=\"foo\">\\n')\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;/a href=&quot;foo&quot;&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_backslash_in_attribute_value_is_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-backslash-inert: a backslash inside a tag attribute value is kept as written.\"\"\"\n    tag = '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + tag + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {tag}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Open, closing and empty-element tags ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"tag\",\n    [\n        \"<a>\",\n        \"<a/>\",\n        \"<a  />\",\n        \"<b2/>\",\n        \"<a-b c-d>\",\n        \"<a h=x>\",\n        \"<a h='x'>\",\n        '<a h=\"x y\">',\n        \"<a b>\",\n        \"<a b c>\",\n        \"<a b = c>\",\n        \"<a _b:c.d-e=1>\",\n        \"<a\\nb>\",\n        \"<a  /><b2\\ndata=\\\"foo\\\" >\",\n        \"<a \\n  b=\\\"c\\\">\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_legal_open_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"tag\", [\"</a>\", \"</a >\", \"</a\\n>\", \"</a\\t  >\", \"</a-b2>\"])\ndef test_legal_closing_tag_passes_through_unchanged(tag: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(tag) == tag\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        ('<a b=\"x\"c>', \"&lt;a b=&quot;x&quot;c&gt;\"),\n        ('<a b=\"unclosed>', \"&lt;a b=&quot;unclosed&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=>\", \"&lt;a b=&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=x y='z>\", \"&lt;a b=x y='z&gt;\"),\n        ('<a b=x\"y>', \"&lt;a b=x&quot;y&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a=b>\", \"&lt;a=b&gt;\"),\n        (\"<1a>\", \"&lt;1a&gt;\"),\n        (\"<-a>\", \"&lt;-a&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=c<d>\", \"&lt;a b=c&lt;d&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a b=c`>\", \"&lt;a b=c`&gt;\"),\n        (\"<a\\n\\nb>\", \"&lt;a\\n\\nb&gt;\"),\n        (\"</a/>\", \"&lt;/a/&gt;\"),\n        (\"</a b>\", \"&lt;/a href=\"\\\\*\">') == '<a href=\"\\\\*\">'\n\n\ndef test_unquoted_attribute_value_containing_a_backslash_is_passed_through() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a b=\\\\*>\") == \"<a ?>\", \"<?>?>\"])\ndef test_legal_processing_instruction_passes_through_unchanged(instruction: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(instruction) == instruction\n\n\ndef test_unclosed_processing_instruction_is_escaped_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<?php echo\") == \"&lt;?php echo\"\n\n\n# --- Declarations \"&lt;!a\"), (\"<!>\", \"&lt;!&gt;\")],\n)\ndef test_illegal_declaration_is_escaped_text(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\n# --- CDATA sections ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"section\", [\"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\", \"<![CDATA[]]>\", \"<![CDATA[a\\nb]]>\"])\ndef test_legal_cdata_section_passes_through_unchanged(section: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(section) == section\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<![CDATA[ unclosed\", \"&lt;![CDATA[ unclosed\"),\n test_raw_tag_inside_text_keeps_surrounding_escapes() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('say \"hi\" <b class=\"x\">') == 'say &quot;hi&quot; <b class=\"x\">'\n\n\ndef  \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;/a href=&quot;foo&quot;&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_backslash_in_attribute_value_is_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {tag}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Open, closing and empty-element tags ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"tag\",\n return raw\n\n    render_source([\"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"], recording_hook)\n    assert calls == [\"one\\ntwo\", \"three\"]\n\n\ndef No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink is one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_corpus_section_passes_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-corpus-section: the scoped Autolinks conformance section exits 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Autolinks$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a href=\"ab:x\">ab:x</a>'),\n        (\"<a+b+c:d>\", '<a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<a.b-c:d>\", '<a href=\"a.b-c:d\">a.b-c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\", '<a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a>'),\n        (\"<localhost:5001/foo>\", '<a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a>'),\n        (\"<https://../>\", '<a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a>'\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_33_characters_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    uri = \"a\" * 33 + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"address\",\n    [\n        \"foo@-bar.com\",\n        \"foo@bar-.com\",\n        \"foo@bar..com\",\n        \"@bar.com\",\n        \"foo@\",\n        \"foo
